app.name: Buildnexa
app.tagline: One platform. Every project. In sync.
auth.notConfigured: Login is not configured yet. Register a public OIDC client and set VITE_BLOCKS_OIDC_CLIENT_ID in .env.
auth.subtitle: Sign in to your Buildnexa account.
auth.inviteOnly: Buildnexa accounts are by invitation. Ask your company admin for access.
auth.errorInvalid: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
auth.errorNetwork: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.errorTooMany: Too many attempts. For your security, sign-in is paused for 5 minutes. Try again then, or reset your password.
auth.errorLocked: This account can't sign in yet. If you were just invited, open the invitation email first.
auth.forgotText: Enter your work email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.sentText: If {email} has a Buildnexa account, a reset link is on its way. It can take a minute to arrive.
auth.errorName: Enter your first and last name.
auth.errorPasswordShort: Use at least {min} characters for your password.
auth.errorPasswordLong: Use at most {max} characters for your password.
auth.activateText: You've been invited to Buildnexa. Confirm your name and choose a password.
auth.inviteDeadTitle: This invitation link no longer works
auth.inviteDeadText: It has expired or was already used. If you already set your password, sign in. Otherwise ask your company admin to send a new invitation.
auth.resetText: Enter a new password for your Buildnexa account.
auth.resetDeadTitle: This reset link no longer works
auth.resetDeadText: Reset links are valid for 10 minutes and work once. Go back to sign in and choose "Forgot password?" to get a new one.
auth.noticeActivated: Your account is ready. Sign in with your email and new password.
auth.noticeReset: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth.heroText: Drawings, RFIs, submittals, daily logs and punch lists for the whole project team, in the office and on site.
auth.heroRfis: RFIs and submittals with a clear ball in court
auth.heroPunch: Daily logs and punch lists from the field
profile.subtitle: Signed-in user details from Blocks IAM.
profile.title: Profile
coadmin.title: Company admin
coadmin.subtitle: Company-wide people, defaults and branding used by every new project
coadmin.adminsOnly: Only company admins can open this page.
coadmin.notBuilt: This tab isn't built yet. It comes {when}.
coadmin.emptyText: Clear the filters or invite someone.
coadmin.cantChangeOwn: You cannot change your own role
coadmin.deactivated: {name} deactivated · access to this company removed
coadmin.deactivateNote: Deactivating removes the person's access to your company and keeps every record they created (records are never deleted); the name is anonymised only on a GDPR erasure request.
coadmin.taken: This person already has an account in your company
coadmin.inviteNote: The invite is an email link to set up a Buildnexa account, valid for 24 hours (Resend sends a new one). The person joins your company once and is added to each ticked project with this role; people from partner companies only see the projects they're added to.
prj.title: All projects
prj.subtitle: Every project you belong to in this company, one login. Projects you're not on stay hidden.
prj.cantCreate: For now only Company Admins create projects
prj.dashboardLater: RFI, punch and change-order numbers per project appear here once those modules are built.
prj.kpi.progressHint: Real progress comes with daily logs
prj.noneCreate: Create the first project with New project.
prj.noneAsk: Ask your Project Manager to add you to a project.
prj.noMatchText: Try another stage or search term.
prj.progressTitle: Share of the planned time already gone. Real progress comes with daily logs.
prj.notYet: Comes with the RFI, submittal and punch modules
prj.f.name: Project name *
prj.err.name: Name is required
prj.err.dates: End date must be after the start date
prj.tpl.defaultsText: Cost code set, trades, disciplines and RFI/submittal due-date defaults from Company admin (ADM-03).
prj.tpl.copyText: Reuse another job's setup. Records (RFIs, logs, punch) are never copied.
prj.tpl.note: Due-date defaults (RFIs and punch 7 working days, submittals 10) are set now. Cost codes, disciplines and document folders are added when those modules are built.
prj.team.note: You ({name}) become Project Manager automatically. Pick people already in your company and set each person's project role. To add someone new, invite them in Company admin › People first.
prj.team.unknown: Not in your company yet: {emails}. Invite them in Company admin › People first, or remove the row.
prj.r.note: Creating the project sets up its team inside your company account. Target: create to first RFI in under 10 minutes.
prj.done.title: Project created
prj.done.created: Project created in your company account
prj.done.pm: You were added as Project Manager
prj.done.later: Folders, cost codes and disciplines are set up once those modules are built.
dir.title: Directory
dir.subtitle: {project}: everyone on this project and the companies they work for. Roles are per project.
dir.editReason: For now only Company Admins change the team
dir.lastActiveLater: Shown on Company admin › People for now
dir.adminOnly: Only a Company Admin can do this
dir.listsLater: Distribution lists come with RFIs and submittals (Phase 2).
dir.removeText: {name} ({company}) loses access to {project} immediately. Their account and other projects are not affected.
dir.removeNote: Records they created or answered stay on the project and in the audit trail. Records are voided, never deleted.
dir.f.title: Title
dir.ballLater: Ball-in-court counts (RFIs, submittals, punch items) appear here once those modules are built.
dir.choosePerson: Choose a person from your company
dir.everyoneOn: Everyone in your company is already on this project
dir.mismatch: {company} is not the usual company type for {role}. Check before adding.
dir.newPersonNote: Someone not in your company yet is invited in Company admin › People first, then added here.
shell.searchLater: Search across the project comes in release 2
shell.notificationsError: Notifications could not be loaded. They will try again shortly.
shell.noNotificationsText: You'll be told here when something needs you, for example an RFI assigned to you.
shell.noAccessText: Your role on this project doesn't include it. Access is checked on the server too; hiding the menu item is never the only control.
shell.phase2: {module} comes in Phase 2, which builds RFIs, the inbox, photos and documents. The demo app shows how it will look.
shell.phase3: {module} comes in Phase 3, which builds the field modules: drawings, punch list, daily logs and the phone layout. The demo app shows how it will look.
shell.phase4: {module} comes in Phase 4, which builds the commercial modules: submittals, budget and change orders. The demo app shows how it will look.
shell.phase5: {module} comes in Phase 5, which builds admin, reports and the final checks before go-live. The demo app shows how it will look.
home.ownerNote: Owner view: dashboards and records are read-only. You can approve or reject owner change orders assigned to you.
home.subNote: You see only your company's items and items you created. Cost fields are hidden for subcontractors.
home.emptyText: Set up the team in the Directory now. Drawings, RFIs and punch items arrive with their modules; target: create to first RFI in under 10 minutes.
home.myItemsHint: Ball-in-court on you, sorted by due date
home.nothingText: RFIs, submittals and punch items that need you will be listed here.
home.noLogPrecon: Daily logs start when construction starts.
plat.subtitle: Buildnexa operations: customer companies, usage and platform admins. Project records stay with each company.
plat.companiesNext: Every customer company will be listed here, and you'll create new ones: company name, short name and the first company admin, who gets an invite email.
plat.usageNext: Projects and people per company, once the company list is in.
plat.adminsNext: Add or remove other platform admins. Nobody can remove themselves or the last platform admin.
plat.later: {module} comes with the admin and hardening work in Phase 5.
plat.note: Platform admins see companies and usage only, never project records.
shell.noAccessPlatformText: This page is for people who work in a customer company. Platform admins see companies and usage only. Access is checked on the server too.
plat.noneText: Create the first customer company. Its first company admin gets an invite email and sets up the rest.
plat.companyExplain: A customer company is one Blocks organization holding all its projects, people and partner companies. The server keeps companies apart.
plat.detailNote: Platform admins see company details and usage only. Opening project records needs the company to add you to a project.
plat.f.name: Customer company name
plat.f.shortHint: Made from the company name. Can't be changed later.
plat.f.shortBad: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; "admin" is reserved.
plat.f.shortTaken: Another company already uses this short name.
plat.createNote: Creates the company's Blocks organization, switches on the bell for its people, and invites the first company admin (Blocks sends the email; the link works for 24 hours). The admin then invites people and creates projects.
plat.headroomNote: Targets from the PRD: 500 projects and 2 000 people per company (to verify on Blocks). Storage and record counts come later.
coadmin.onlyAdminYou: You're the only company admin. Make a colleague a company admin too, so your company can still be managed when you're away.
coadmin.onlyAdmin: {name} is the only company admin. Make a second person a company admin, so the company can still be managed when they're away.
coadmin.makeAdminText: {name} will be able to invite and deactivate people, create projects, change teams and make or remove other company admins. Only give this to people you trust with the whole company.
coadmin.removeAdminText: {name} becomes normal staff with the default role {role}. They keep their projects and project roles but can no longer manage the company.
plat.addCoAdminText: For support: when {name} has lost its admin. A new email gets an invite; someone already in the company is made admin. Only the company's own staff can be admins.
plat.coAdminInvited: Invite sent to {email} as company admin of {name}
plat.coAdminAdded: {email} is now a company admin of {name}
plat.admin.explain: Platform admins create and look after customer companies. They never see project records.
plat.admin.addWarn: This is the strongest right in Buildnexa: platform admins create companies, add company admins and add or remove other platform admins. Only add people from your own operations team.
plat.admin.removeText: {name} will no longer see Platform admin. Any company they belong to is not affected.
plat.admin.cantSelf: Another platform admin has to remove you
plat.admin.cantLast: The platform needs at least one platform admin
plat.admin.onlyOne: There is only one platform admin. Add a second one, so customer onboarding never depends on one person.
plat.admin.invitedToast: Invite sent to {email} as platform admin
plat.admin.removedToast: {name} is no longer a platform admin
profile.noAccess: No access yet. Ask your company admin.
plat.tagHint: The company's technical ID, as the Blocks console shows it. Only needed for support.
plat.f.advanced: Advanced: choose the short name yourself
plat.f.shortNeeded: This name has no letters or digits to build a short name from. Open Advanced and choose one.
plat.f.nameTaken: A company with this name already exists.
